A financial ecosystem is forming around Nvidia's graphics processing units (GPUs), as Wall Street tries to turn the AI chips into a new asset class, like real estate, oil, and agricultural commodities. The AI boom sparked a scramble for Nvidia's cutting-edge chips — and a financial market has emerged because they're too expensive to buy outright. month.summary: Five American technology companies are pledging $2.4B in AI tools and compute credits to federal science at a White House summit, with Nvidia giving $1B and Google the smallest share at $150M. The sam...
highlights: Five American technology companies are pledging $2.4B in AI tools and compute credits to federal science at a White House summit, with Nvidia giving $1B and Google the smallest share at $150M. The same administration suspended Microsoft from a residency programme hours earlier, and Britain’s regulator named three of the five donors that morning. Five American technology companies are pledging $2.4B to federal science. Nvidia is giving $1B, AMD $500M, OpenAI $200M, and Anthropic and Google $150M each. The money takes the form of AI tools and compute credits for the Genesis Mission. Trump announces it on Thursday at a Washington summit called Science: A New Golden Age, which also carries more than $100M for science and engineering education. The Information Commissioner’s Office named Google, OpenAI and Anthropic among ten developers it had secured changes from after two years of scrutiny, and opened a call for evidence on how organisations manage the risks from AI agents.
